== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] large [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]], peeled and halved 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Peach Nectar|peach nectar]]
* ½ cup dark [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ¼ cup crystallized ginger, finely [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* ¼ tsp salt
* Melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] as needed

== Procedure ==
#Combine liquid ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium high heat until reduced by half.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] peaches with melted butter and place on a medium [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] until well marked, brushing with nectar mixture often.
#Pour remaining glaze into large bowl and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] with peaches; serve.
